intro.text: A pentagonal sea of zephyr spores, which give off air when wet. It is thought one of the safer seas to cross, and various peoples live there.

description.text: Most of its people live on islands, many of them unusually large by local standards. One holds a city that serves as capital of the sea and of the Islands of Lobu, whose people take pride in hunting. The Zephyr Islands are known for their pottery.
